name: Blood Pact grants 50 dodge and its conditional healing clause (#3245)
contract: Blood Pact 801955 ships three SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects in Spell.dbc. Effect 0 is aura 185 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_RANGED_HIT_CHANCE with BasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50, live in Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst. Effect 2 is aura 49 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DODGE_PERCENT with BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50 (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModDodgePercent). Effect 1 is aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT with BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, which is the description's conditional $?s560257[...] clause: Blood Runs Cold 560257 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20 and SpellClassMask (0, 0, 65536), which matches Blood Pact's own SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 65536), so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue raises effect 1 to 20% once it is learned. Both halves are native. NOT covered here: the description's closing sentence "While active you can dodge or parry while casting." Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst (Unit.cpp:3099/3131) and Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst's spell variant (Unit.cpp:3533/3552) zero dodge and parry through victim->IsNonMeleeSpellCast(false, victim->CanDefendDuringChannel(), true), and Unit::CanDefendDuringChannel exempts only a Demon Hunter channeling 800206. The harness reads dodge_chance and parry_chance as field values and counts melee packets, but has no per-swing outcome metric, so that clause cannot be discriminated here and is left to a Ghost e2e combat-log test.

steps.label: The healing clause is 0 until Blood Runs Cold is learned
Blood Runs Cold raises it to the shipped 20%
Blood Pact is active on its caster
Dodge chance rises by 50 percentage points
The ranged-hit penalty carries the shipped -50
